# Budgetum

> Budgetum is a budget planner and expense tracker for iPhone and Android. You plan income and spending by category for a month or a custom period (for example payday to payday), record transactions, and compare planned with actual amounts. It works offline, needs no account, and keeps financial data on the device.

Key facts:

- Platforms: iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play). On a computer, Desktop Analytics at https://budgetum.app/analytics opens an export from the app in the browser; the file is read locally.
- Privacy: no account, no cloud sync, no bank connection. Data stays on the device; backups are files the user saves.
- Offline: all core budgeting works offline. Only optional extras use the internet (shared plan links, exchange-rate suggestions, purchases).
- Free vs Pro: core budgeting, tracking, and analytics are free. Budgetum Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. Pro unlocks more than 5 recurring transactions, more than 5 tags, Saved Sets (including Sets on the Budget screen), and bank statement matching.
- Import: Budgetum CSV, YNAB Register.csv, or any other CSV with column mapping. Pro can match a CSV or XLSX bank statement against an account.
- Languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Russian, Ukrainian.
- Support: support@budgetum.app. Budgetum AI Assistant (ChatGPT): https://chatgpt.com/g/g-69773bdf40b481919998c32dd3b6ed7a-budgetum-assistant

The Help Center (https://budgetum.app/help) documents every screen. All guides in one file: https://budgetum.app/llms-full.txt
